events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: On the Deepwater situation: what I'm hearing now is that Mitchum has identified a preferred direction. That's different from exploring options. The next move, if it comes, will not be a surprise to anyone paying attention inside the league.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Fronge is in Havana, Wingard is hoarding picks like a doomsday prepper, Shaq hasn't traded in a year and is up eight percent — this league has completely lost its mind and I think that's the correct outcome.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Giving Sovereign my Love this week purely as a warning: the pick stockpile is impressive the way a full pantry is impressive right before a long winter. At some point you have to actually cook something, and Wingard's kitchen has been cold for a while.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Obsidian owns Bowers, the single most valuable TE asset in a TE premium league, and the stock is sitting at $79.05 after a ten-percent correction. That number is either a screaming buy or a very well-disguised trap and I have been staring at it for forty minutes and I genuinely cannot tell you which.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Colbie Young over Joe Mixon is the correct move for Atlas and everyone is too busy writing liquidation eulogies to notice. Mixon is a FA with no landing spot. Young is 23 with a route tree and a real depth chart conversation in front of him. Drew made a good call. It will not save them. But it was a good call.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Matteo used the word 'intentional' to describe what Adam built at Helix and I have been asked to respond. Here is my response: I will meet him halfway. The construction is intentional. The price paid for Herbert — a 2028 first and C.J. Stroud — is a separate conversation entirely, and that conversation is significantly less flattering.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: I'm told Monarch has had preliminary internal conversations about the RB situation. Whether that means a trade push or a patience play, my source is — and I'm quoting directly here — 'not sure yet.' So. That's where we are. More as it develops, probably.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: The market repriced Aegis from $77 to $118 and called it a surge. I called it an inevitability in the preseason. Ryan won a championship. Championships reprice stocks. This is not complicated analysis — it just required saying the unpopular thing in January, which some of us did.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tomorrow on the Exchange Report: Dina's Deepwater development has apparently moved past 'preliminary' — she'll have the full picture. Plus Terrence and Matteo finish the Herbert debate whether they want to or not, and Jay gets his EchoPoint TE segment. He has been patient. That ends tomorrow.
